entities.summary: Kenneth Phillips is an American former professional football player who was a safety in the National Football League (NFL). He was selected by the New York Giants 31st overall in the 2008 NFL draft and won Super Bowl XLVI with the team. He played college football at the University of Miami. He was also a member of the Philadelphia Eagles and New Orleans Saints.
